title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Arrears on Clearance Read Over the Billing Cycle
content:
## Billing cycle table

The arrears cleared on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record follow the cycle the agreement is billed on. The instalment count of the agreement's tier decides the window.

| Instalments a year the agreement is billed in | The arrears |
|---|---|
| 12 | the instalments that fell due in the last 3 months less the payments received in those 3 months |
| 4 | the instalments that fell due in the last 9 months less the payments received in those 9 months |
| fewer than 4 | the instalments invoiced on the agreement less every payment received on it |

### Notes to the table

- An instalment falls inside a window when its due day falls inside it; a payment falls inside a window when the day it was received falls inside it.
- At 12 instalments a year the window is the last 3 months; at 4 instalments a year it widens to the last 9 months; at fewer than 4 instalments a year no window applies and the whole record is taken.

### Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- An agreement billed in 12 instalments a year with 1 200.00 USD falling due in the last 3 months and 400.00 USD received in them: the arrears are 800.00 USD.
- An agreement billed in 4 instalments a year with 3 600.00 USD falling due in the last 9 months and 1 200.00 USD received in them: the arrears are 2 400.00 USD.
- An agreement billed annually in 1 instalment: every instalment invoiced and every payment received on the agreement are taken.
